originals.ko: 너 나이 든 여자에 대한 그 영화를 좋아해?
originals.why: Natural North Welsh. licio'r ffilm 'na means 'like that film', the same sense as this LEGO.

originals.ko: 나는 진한 커피 아니면 차 한 잔 하고 싶어
originals.why: Valid colloquial North Welsh. It is the same seed in the source course and only the LEGO differs.

topups.why: '좋아하지 않을 것 같아' adds 'I think' and does not pin the conditional fydden, so more than one Welsh answer fits.
os gwelwch yn dda is the chi form, but the Korean 부탁해 is 반말. Not needed after the four kept.
The Korean is unnatural ('받을 수 있을까 부탁해') and is 반말 for a chi-form request.
